**No – you are not eligible to renew your hostel room for the next academic year.**  

**Why:**  

| Requirement (Hostel Rules §3) | Your status | Meets requirement? |
|---|---|---|
| CGPA ≥ 6.0 | 7.45 ≥ 6.0 | ✅ [SQL] |
| No overdue fee dues | Tuition Inst‑1 ₹87,000 is **overdue** (status “overdue”) | ❌ [SQL] |
| ≤ 1 disciplinary warning | No record shown (assumed ≤ 1) | ✅ (not a blocking factor) |

Because you have an overdue tuition component, the condition “no overdue fee dues of any kind in the fee ledger” is not satisfied [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3 Renewal for the next academic year]. Consequently, you cannot renew the hostel room during the renewal window (1 April – 30 April 2027) [Doc: Hostel Rules & Allotment Policy 2026-27 §3].

**Overdue items in your ledger**

| Component | Amount due | Amount paid | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| tuition_inst1 | ₹87,000 | ₹0 | overdue [SQL] |

You must clear this overdue tuition balance (and obtain a no‑dues certificate) before you can apply for renewal in the next window.
sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.full_name, s.cgpa, s.is_hosteller, fl.component, fl.amount_due, fl.amount_paid, fl.status FROM students AS s JOIN fee_ledger AS fl ON fl.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.student_id = 'S2025CS003' ORDER BY fl.due_date LIMIT 50
